name: Summit AZ - Supporting Blog Strategy 2026-09-01
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-01

# Summary
Five supporting blog posts aimed at pages stuck at positions 3 to 5 (the five tracked rows were really four pages). Built from GSC Jul 1 to Aug 30, 2026 and the two position trackers saved the day before.

# Fixes recommended first
- Tankless: Chandler, Tempe, Gilbert and Queen Creek all targeted "tankless water heater installation near me". Let Chandler own it; point the others at their own city names.
- Sewer: San Tan Valley, Chandler and Phoenix all targeted "residential sewer line repair". Let San Tan Valley own it; Chandler keeps "sewer line repair chandler az".

# The 5 blogs
1. Old and Cracked Pipes in Scottsdale Homes, to /pipe-lining-scottsdale/ (replaced the roof drain idea; Summit does not do roof drains). Drafted and published (post 6108, per the Sep 1 work report).
2. Sewer Line Repair vs. Replacement, to /sewer-line-repair-san-tan-valley/ (drafted and scheduled).
3. What to Expect Installing a Tankless Water Heater, to /tankless-water-heater-installation-chandler/.
4. Why Chandler Homes Get Sewer Line Problems, to /sewer-line-repair-chandler/.
5. What a Sewer Camera Inspection Finds, to /sewer-line-repair-san-tan-valley/.
- Language rule for blog 1: do not use "pipe lining" or "trenchless"; describe the fix plainly.

# Data files folded in
- `Summit-AZ-Position-2-Tracker-2026-08-31.csv`: 18 page/query pairs at position 2 (12 branded, 3 junk, 3 real non-branded).
- `Summit-AZ-Position-3-5-Tracker-2026-08-31.csv`: 48 pairs at positions 3 to 5, prioritized non-branded first.

# Decisions and status
- The Oct 1 handoff notes that blogs 3 to 5 from this strategy were never written.
